incident_text: Smoke is rising from the hills behind the village and flames are visible near the first houses. A strong wind is blowing toward the village.

result.scene_summary: A large wildfire is burning on a hillside at night, with intense orange and yellow flames and smoke illuminating the sky and reflecting on a body of water below.

observations.description: Bright orange and yellow flames actively burning along the hillside.
Large plume of dark smoke and fire glow filling the upper portion of the image.
Reflection of fire light on a dark body of water in the foreground.
Structure resembling a highway overpass or sign support in the foreground.

not_determinable: structural integrity of hillside or infrastructure
